digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text live harness + inbound echo-suppression
propositions: Live Jira DC harness asserts rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields for rich-text (bold/heading/code-macro) after pushing via rebar.edit_ticket + run_bridge sync
Second reconcile pass against live instance with converged rich body computes zero inbound mutations (state-based echo-safety), proving Markdown→wiki→rendered-wiki roundtrip converges to unchanged

Concurrent both-sides edit (rebar-side + Jira-side description change) before next pass emits local-wins (rebar's body landed) + deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with remote value recorded, not clobbered

Inbound differ now normalizes descriptions via landed wire form (map_fields_to_remote) to suppress echo when Jira's rendered wiki matches local body's encoded form, fixing codec-aware inbound echo-suppression gap

Cross-repo contract test pins InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior (None→'', plain str→identity, ADF dict→adf_to_text markdown) to fail breaking changes on agentic-dev-platform imports

Live test module reuses existing Docker DC-harness conftest fixtures (dc_store_copy_repo, dc_transport, bound_dc_issue, dc_request) and skip markers (absent-harness, absent-extra) in existing amd64 CI job (no new job)
